q: In a stdio MCP server, where must debug logs go?
explain: stdout carries only protocol messages; anything else corrupts the stream.

q: What changed for Streamable HTTP in 2026-07-28?
options: Protocol sessions and SSE stream resumability were removed
explain: Requests are self-contained; a dropped stream means retry (verified Nov 2026).

q: Why should a local HTTP MCP server validate the Origin header?
options: To stop malicious web pages reaching it through DNS rebinding
explain: The specification calls this out for servers on localhost.
